topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The sun feels just right today, warming the earth and everything in it. I move through the forest, my steps light, my senses alive with the scent of fresh pine and the distant, lively chirping of birds. There's a buzz of activity around me, as if the whole forest is sharing in my buoyant stride. A young one, caught in the tangled web of copying another's hunt, comes to mind. I can almost taste the air of misunderstanding, but worry not, for the forest is vast and forgiving. Each leaf, each blade of grass, whispers the lesson of the unique path every creature must walk. Today, I find myself easily sidestepping shadows and moving with the grace of the wind, a dance that feels as natural as breathing.
